column1: # External import stubs - EC-7 family C, declared on
# Selector: every function in functions.tsv (non-funclet) of body_bytes 6 or 7 whose
# complete body is FF 25 rel32 (or 48 FF 25 rel32) and whose target lands inside the
# PE IMPORT ADDRESS TABLE (data directory 12, VA 008C2000..008C31C0). Each member is
# resolved to its DLL and symbol through the import directory (data directory 1) and
# the pairs are listed in external-import-stubs-map.tsv beside this file.
# Control: the count 117 was derived from the PE import tables and matches the
# checkpoint tag Thunk.ExternalImport exactly - two unrelated instruments, same line.
# EXCLUDED, deliberately: 00809958 jumps through 008C31C0, which is ONE SLOT PAST the
# end of the IAT and is GuardCFCheckFunctionPointer in the load config directory. It
# is the Control Flow Guard check dispatcher, not an import stub. See section 12.
# One function entry address per line, VA (image base 0x00120000 included).
